name: Haugbui
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: The languages it knew in life
notes: CR 3. Barrow-wight. Bound to burial site. Campaign-custom creature.
gm_notes: Session 3 Germanic forest burial mounds. Bound to its burial site -- cannot move more than 100 ft from its mound. Will not pursue beyond that range. Haunts barrows, attacks those who disturb the mound. Resistance to nonmagical weapons.
